cantrip.label: Cantrip
cantrip.description: Dictation, saved recordings, recovery, and setup

cantrip.raw.label: Toggle raw dictation
cantrip.raw.description: Same action as Super+R; delivers recognizer text without aliases or LLM cleanup

cantrip.clean.label: Toggle clean dictation
cantrip.clean.description: Same action as Super+Shift+R; applies vocabulary aliases, then any configured LLM cleanup

cantrip.elevate.label: Toggle elevate dictation
cantrip.elevate.description: Applies vocabulary aliases, then the Elevate model's clearer, more articulate version

cantrip.default-raw.label: Default mode: Raw
cantrip.default-raw.description: Takes started without a per-take mode use it; a running take keeps its own

cantrip.default-clean.label: Default mode: Clean
cantrip.default-clean.description: Takes started without a per-take mode use it; a running take keeps its own

cantrip.default-elevate.label: Default mode: Elevate
cantrip.default-elevate.description: Takes started without a per-take mode use it; a running take keeps its own

cantrip.cancel.label: Cancel without delivery
cantrip.cancel.description: Discard active capture, or cancel processing and keep recovery evidence

cantrip.recordings.label: Recordings and recovery
cantrip.recordings.description: Choose a saved take; copy its transcript, recover to clipboard, or forget its audio

cantrip.dismiss.label: Dismiss current notice
cantrip.dismiss.description: Hide the current notice without deleting any recording

cantrip.settings.label: Settings
cantrip.settings.description: Input, modes and their models, provider configuration, state labels, and reduced motion

cantrip.check.label: Check setup
cantrip.check.description: Native setup diagnosis, local model installation, and OS-keyring credentials
